intro: Echeyakee's Hide is the pale pelt taken from the legendary white lion known as Whitemist in the Barrens. Revered by the tauren as an embodiment of mercy and death, the pelt serves as proof of a hunter's prowess for Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads.

p: In the Taur-ahe tongue, Echeyakee means Whitemist. The predator earned the title among the savannah lions for his stealthy white coat and the swiftness with which he took down prey, ending their lives before fear or pain could take hold. Claiming the beast's pelt requires summoning the elusive cat near giant kodo bones northeast of the Crossroads with a ceremonial horn. To present this hide to Sergra Darkthorn is not just to prove martial skill, but to honor the predator's silent, merciful end.
